Class AbstractDAO<T>

java.lang.Object
DataAccess.AbstractDAO<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of the entity handled by this DAO
Direct Known Subclasses:
BillDAO, ClientDAO, OrderDAO, ProductDAO
public class AbstractDAO<T> extends Object
Abstract generic Data Access Object (DAO) class that provides basic CRUD operations for any data model class using Java Reflection and JDBC.

It is designed to work with JavaBeans-style classes, where each property has a corresponding getter and setter method.

Intended to be extended by concrete DAO classes such as ProductDAO, OrderDAO, etc.
